acceptanceCriteria: companionrelease includes corvint-ruby-test-provider with manifest/checksum coverage and a test
Release docs list the Ruby provider
body: PR #1135 adds cmd/corvint-ruby-test-provider but internal/companionrelease (the release bundle of companion binaries) lists only the js and go test providers, so a release would not ship the Ruby provider and test-validity's Ruby producer hint would name a binary users cannot install.
title: corvint-ruby-test-provider is not shipped: internal/companionrelease lists only the JS and Go providers (residual of PR #1135)
